sections.heading: Need continuous evidence for regulatory readiness?
sections.body: A point-in-time assessment does not show how controls and exposures change after it is issued. Risk, technology and assurance teams need a shared view of requirements, control ownership and remediation status. The first task is to agree the regulatory scope and the evidence each owner needs.

sections.heading: Keep readiness evidence current and usable
sections.body: The intended outcome is a maintained view of validated exposures, mapped controls and remediation evidence. Connect findings to responsible owners and the requirements agreed for your organisation. Assess progress through closure evidence, control gaps and evidence freshness; regulatory decisions remain with your accountable risk and compliance owners.

sections.heading: Buyer questions
sections.description: Clarify scope, evidence and accountability before agreeing an engagement.

items.title: Which regulatory frameworks can you cover?
items.description: We agree the applicable obligations, jurisdictions and control frameworks with your risk and compliance team before proposing scope. Share your required frameworks so we can discuss relevant mapping artefacts, evidence requirements and the boundaries of the engagement.

items.title: Is this an audit or a compliance sign-off?
items.description: The play supports readiness and evidence preparation. Statutory audit, legal interpretation and final compliance decisions remain with your appointed authorities and accountable organisational owners.

items.title: How does evidence stay current?
items.description: Agree a review cadence, asset scope, evidence sources and control owners. Exposure changes, remediation verification and accepted risks can then be recorded in the maintained evidence register.

items.title: Is this a channel for an active incident?
items.description: The enquiry form below is for planned engagements, not active-incident reporting. Monitoring coverage, escalation routes and incident support must be agreed within a [security operations engagement](/services/cyber-security/security-operations).
